note: Record of the 32 px trial, superseded by 64 px and the scatter route (DECISIONS 2026-10-18); not a live spec. The ground trial at 32 px per tile by the text-grid route (DECISIONS 2026-10-18, the retry of the finer-grid failure): meadow, sand, rock and water from docs/design/STYLE.md section 3, three variants each. Run one at a time: pnpm kit:gen tools/kit-gen/ground-32.json --only meadow_1. Output in .scratch/kit-gen/ground-32/, nothing goes into content/.

entries.name: meadow_1
entries.detail: a flat base green #4c9a3f, 8 to 10 tufts spread over the tile, each a V of 5 pixels in the lighter green #84c450 (a row of letters e c c c e over c e c e c over c c e c c, so wider than tall), a darker #2e6b3b pixel under the point of some tufts, and about 8 single darker #2e6b3b pixels between them
